name: Campayn
description_en:
Campayn is an email-marketing service for designing newsletters, maintaining contact lists and sending scheduled or automated communication. The official product is called Campayn; the imported directory name accidentally included “Pricing, Reviews and,” which has been removed without changing the record slug.

Its official pages describe templates, forms, segmentation and trigger-based messages. Several older feature URLs now resolve to the same overview. The available pages establish broad capabilities and plan differences, but do not establish detailed retry, migration or API behavior; those gaps are kept explicit.
description_zh:
Campayn 是用于设计简报、维护联系人名单以及发送排程或自动沟通的邮件营销服务。官网产品名为 Campayn，原目录名称误带的“Pricing, Reviews and”已移除，档案 slug 保持不变。

官方页面介绍模板、表单、分组和触发邮件，多个旧功能网址已归到同一概览页。可读资料能支持主要能力和套餐区别，但不能证明详细的重试、迁移或 API 行为，相关缺口仍明确保留。

core_features.explanation_en: Use a responsive template or drag-and-drop design; custom HTML is plan-dependent.
core_features.explanation_zh: 使用响应式模板或拖放设计；自定义 HTML 受套餐条件限制。

core_features.explanation_en: Hosted or embedded forms collect addresses; double opt-in asks new subscribers to confirm.
core_features.explanation_zh: 托管或嵌入表单收集邮箱，双重确认要求新订阅者确认加入。

core_features.explanation_en: Official examples include welcome, birthday and blog-update messages.
core_features.explanation_zh: 官方示例包括欢迎、生日和博客更新邮件。

en: Prepare a workshop newsletter with a calendar and location link.
Evaluate a welcome autoresponder or date-based birthday message.
zh: 制作带日历和地点链接的工作坊简报。
评估欢迎自动回复或按日期发送的生日邮件。
use_cases.basis: Editorial workflow examples; not observed customer outcomes.

steps.en: Confirm permission and inspect a small CSV import.
steps.zh: 确认接收许可并检查小范围 CSV 导入。

steps.en: Choose the documented automation and content capabilities for the actual plan.
steps.zh: 按实际套餐选择已记录的自动化和内容能力。

steps.en: Check final links, recipients and current support instructions before sending.
steps.zh: 发送前检查最终链接、收件人及当前支持说明。

items.en: Several old feature URLs now return one overview; detailed lifecycle and retry semantics remain unverified.
items.zh: 多个旧功能网址现返回同一概览，详细生命周期和重试语义仍未核实。

items.en: Basic lists one autoresponder; complete automation is listed under Unlimited.
items.zh: Basic 列出一个自动回复，完整自动化列在 Unlimited 中。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: Monthly/annual contact tiers and separate non-expiring prepaid credits. Rendered Basic example: $19 USD/month for 3,000 contacts and 15,000 emails; no permanent free allowance confirmed.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 月付／年付联系人档位，以及单独且不过期的预付额度。呈现的 Basic 示例为每月 $19 USD，3,000 位联系人及 15,000 封邮件；未确认持续免费额度。

official_check.scope: Official public documentation only; no purchase, account operation, sending test, identity or publication approval.

review_notes: Original English and corresponding Chinese research draft. Vendor statements describe documented behavior, not independently measured quality.
Existing third-party source is discovery-only and superseded. Unknown UI languages, regional availability and licensing remain unknown.
All publication and alternative-relationship states remain unapproved.

sections.title_en: Start with a newsletter and a defined subscriber group
sections.title_zh: 从简报和明确受众开始
sections.en:
Campayn describes bringing contacts in through CSV upload or pasting and designing a newsletter with templates. The feature overview adds segmentation and hosted or embedded signup forms, with double opt-in confirmation.

For an illustrative local workshop, collect interested subscribers, create an event segment, then prepare an invitation with a location and calendar link. Check the actual segment membership and registration destination before sending. This is an editorial evaluation example rather than an observed deployment.
sections.zh:
Campayn 介绍通过 CSV 上传或粘贴导入联系人，并用模板制作简报。功能概览还提供分组、托管或嵌入订阅表单，以及双重订阅确认。

例如本地工作坊，可收集感兴趣的订阅者、建立活动分组，再制作含地点和日历链接的邀请。发送前应核对分组成员和报名目标。这是编辑评估示例，并非观察到的实际部署。

sections.title_en: Do not equate one autoresponder with the complete suite
sections.title_zh: 一个自动回复不等于完整套件
sections.en:
Campayn’s homepage gives welcome, birthday and new-content messages as automation examples. The pricing view distinguishes Basic’s single autoresponder from Unlimited’s full automation suite and RSS-to-email. Birthday messaging also depends on a stored birth date.

A reader wanting only a welcome response should evaluate that path separately from a branching lifecycle sequence. Exact entry, re-entry, pause and failed-send recovery semantics were not established by the accessible documentation. Do not assume a complex visual workflow exists merely because the directory listed automation.
sections.zh:
官网以欢迎、生日和新内容通知作为自动化示例，价格页区分 Basic 的一个自动回复与 Unlimited 的完整自动化套件及 RSS 转邮件。生日通知还依赖已存储的生日日期。

只需要欢迎回复时，应将该流程与分支生命周期序列分别评估。可读文档未确认详细进入、重新进入、暂停或失败恢复语义，不能仅凭目录标有自动化就推定具备某种复杂流程。

sections.title_en: A file link is different from an attached message payload
sections.title_zh: 文件链接与邮件附件载荷不同
sections.en:
The feature page describes sharing files through a download link, alongside custom HTML, calendar buttons, maps and split testing of up to three content options. Its pricing page places custom HTML, file sharing and dynamic content in the Unlimited feature list.

For the workshop example, inspect the downloaded file and event time rather than assuming the displayed button proves correctness. Also check what the selected plan actually permits. No attachment delivery or rendering across inbox clients was tested.
sections.zh:
功能页描述通过下载链接分享文件，同时介绍自定义 HTML、日历按钮、地图和最多三个内容版本的分流测试。价格页把自定义 HTML、文件分享和动态内容列在 Unlimited 功能中。

在工作坊示例中，应检查下载文件和活动时间，不能只看按钮已显示就视为正确；还需确认所选套餐允许的范围。本文未测试附件投递或各邮箱客户端中的渲染。

sections.title_en: Choose recurring capacity or occasional credits
sections.title_zh: 选择持续容量或偶发额度
sections.en:
The rendered 3,000-contact view shows Basic at $19 USD/month for 15,000 emails and Unlimited at $39 USD/month with unlimited email volume for that contact tier. Annual-payment equivalents also appear. Prepaid credits are offered separately and described as non-expiring; checkout conditions were not tested.

The FAQ excludes unsubscribed and bounced addresses from valid-contact counts and warns when limits are exceeded. It says Canadian customers pay CAD and others USD. Confirm the actual tier, currency and payment cadence; free registration by itself does not establish an ongoing free sending allowance.
sections.zh:
页面呈现的 3,000 位联系人档位中，Basic 为每月 $19 USD，含 15,000 封；Unlimited 为每月 $39 USD，该联系人档位下邮件量不限，同时显示年付月均价格。按次购买的额度单独提供，文档称不过期；结算条件未实测。

FAQ 将已退订和退信地址排除在有效联系人计数之外，并说明超限会提醒。加拿大客户以 CAD 付款，其他客户用 USD。应确认实际档位、币种和周期；免费注册本身不能证明存在持续免费发送额度。

sections.title_en: Hosted campaign review is part of the service boundary
sections.title_zh: 托管内容审查属于服务边界
sections.en:
The service policy says Campayn has access to uploaded distribution lists and campaign content and reviews campaigns for its terms. It also describes vendor access to tracking information. This is relevant when selecting a service to hold a membership audience or commercially sensitive campaign.

Determine what data the operator is allowed to upload and what contractual requirements need a separate review. This profile does not certify privacy compliance, data location or a particular retention period, and it does not establish source-code or self-hosting rights.
sections.zh:
服务政策说明 Campayn 可访问上传的分发名单和活动内容，并按条款检查邮件活动，也描述了厂商对跟踪信息的访问。选择用于保存会员受众或商业敏感活动的服务时，这些边界值得核对。

应明确运营者可以上传哪些数据，以及哪些合同要求需要另外审查。本文不认证隐私合规、数据位置或特定保存期限，也未确认源码或自托管权利。

sections.title_en: Evaluate the accessible product rather than an imported title
sections.title_zh: 依据可读产品资料评估
sections.en:
Campayn is worth shortlisting for a straightforward newsletter or documented autoresponder use case when an operator can review audiences and reports. The product’s own deliverability percentage is marketing material, not a result verified here.

The linked support host was inaccessible during this research, while former individual feature pages redirected to the overview. Before relying on automation for a critical sequence, obtain current instructions for activation, contact import side effects and failed-send handling. Those operational details remain unknown rather than being filled from memory.
sections.zh:
有专人检查受众和报表，且需求是普通简报或文档中的自动回复场景时，可将 Campayn 列入候选。产品自称的投递百分比属于营销资料，本文未予验证。

本次官网链接的支持站无法读取，旧的单功能页则跳转到概览。将自动化用于关键序列前，应取得启用、导入副作用和失败处理的现行说明。这些细节保持未知，不凭记忆补写。

research_gaps.zh: 未测试账户、发送、购买、移动应用或集成；具体结算总额、持续免费容量、界面语言、源码许可和数据位置仍未知。
